releases.name: Omena CSS Modules 5.3.0
distribution: The GitHub Release contains the `5.3.0` VSIX and its SPDX SBOM.
The legacy Visual Studio Marketplace listing `yongsk0066.css-module-explainer` remains at `5.2.0`; it is not evidence that `5.3.0` was published there.

releases.name: Omena Rust crate train and CLI 0.3.0
distribution: The GitHub Release contains native `omena-cli` archives and SHA-256 checksums for version `0.3.0`.
crates.io contains 50 of the 51 publishable workspace crates at `0.3.0`; `omena-reactive` is not published.
npm contains `@omena/wasm@0.3.0`; the latest published `@omena/napi` remains `0.2.1`.
